scripts.bridge: cargo build --release -p fmlibre-bridge --target aarch64-apple-darwin && cargo build --release -p fmlibre-bridge --target x86_64-apple-darwin && mkdir -p ../target/universal-apple-darwin/release && lipo -create -output ../target/universal-apple-darwin/release/libfmlibre_bridge.dylib ../target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/libfmlibre_bridge.dylib ../target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/libfmlibre_bridge.dylib && lipo -create -output ../target/universal-apple-darwin/release/fmlibre-launch ../target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/fmlibre-launch ../target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/fmlibre-launch && codesign --force --sign - ../target/universal-apple-darwin/release/libfmlibre_bridge.dylib ../target/universal-apple-darwin/release/fmlibre-launch
scripts.release:mac: npm run bridge && tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin --bundles app --config src-tauri/tauri.bridge.conf.json
